title: Heat the pot
vo: For the last 45 minutes of the prove, put the empty pot, with its lid on, into the cold oven. Heat the oven to 250 degrees Celsius, or 230 with a fan. Don't oil the pot: the baking paper stops the loaf sticking. Check the knob on the lid. If it isn't rated to 250 degrees, unscrew it, or cover the hole with foil.
voUS: For the last 45 minutes of the prove, put the empty pot, with its lid on, into the cold oven. Heat the oven to 480 degrees Fahrenheit, or 445 with convection. Don't oil the pot: the baking paper stops the loaf sticking. Check the knob on the lid. If it isn't rated to 480 degrees, unscrew it, or cover the hole with foil.
cap: For the last 45 minutes, put the empty pot, lid on, in the cold oven.
Don't oil the pot: the baking paper stops the loaf sticking.
If the lid knob is rated below 250 °C, unscrew it or cover the hole with foil.
